name: Ad angle planner
why: Picks one awareness level and market stage before writing, the same first rung of the planning ladder used in this kit.

name: Seven-bucket ad concept brainstormer
why: Generates concepts in distinct groups and ranks the top eight, which keeps a batch from being variants of one idea.

name: Ad concept matrix builder
why: Turns reviews and product facts into buyer situations with angles and offers in test order.

name: Five-tactic ad hook writer
why: Writes ranked hooks from approved claims, with filming notes, for the hook bank step.

name: Twelve-pattern static ad brief maker
why: Gives static concepts a copy, layout and image brief a designer can build, matched to buyer stage and proof.

name: Static ad critic
why: Scores a finished static ad before spend and suggests two headline rewrites.

name: Sound-off commercial checker
why: Checks that a video script still sells with the sound off, one of this kit's quality-bar checks.

name: Video ad production plan builder
why: Turns an approved script into a timed shot table and edit handoff.

name: Competitor ad theme and gap mapper
why: Sorts rival Meta ads into themes and ranks open lanes, the core of the competitor teardown skill.

name: Ad library teardown counter
why: Counts a rival's Ad Library ads by format, age and awareness stage to find long runners and gaps.

name: Creative test reader
why: Reads a pasted ad export into keep, leave or replace calls and flags false winners.

name: Video hook and hold matrix reviewer
why: Places video ads on a hook and hold grid from view counts, matching this kit's attention-to-result reading order.

name: Ad test sprint runner
why: Plans and reads test rounds and stops after three rounds without a winner, like the weekly creative sprint workflow.
